simple.meaning: עֶכֶס (ʻekeç) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fetter ; hence, an anklet.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֶכֶס (H5914) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 7:22, with occurrences in Proverbs, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֶכֶס (H5914) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֶכֶס (H5914) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֶכֶס (ʻekeç) / H5914 is traced through Proverbs 7:22, Isaiah 3:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5914. ekes [ עֶ֫כֶס ] noun [masculine] anklet, bangle ; — plural absolute הָעֲכֶסִים Isa 3:18 bangles, anklets (as ornaments); for singular absolute ׳ע Prov 7:22 read עֵגֶל Toy.
